content.short: Wolfram Alpha, a major computational knowledge engine providing technology for major services such as Apple’s Siri.
content.description: Wolfram Alpha is a natural language processing tool and a provider to Apple’s Siri and Alexa intelligent assistants. Developed by Wolfram Research, Wolfram Alpha acts as the so-called “answer-engine,” providing answers to factual queries directly by computing the answer from structured data. WBL will integrate Cardano’s blockchain data into Wolfram Alpha, allowing developers to integrate external data into Cardano’s smart contracts.
